definitions.explanation: A sculptural technique where figures are carved so they project from a flat background. Includes bas-relief and high relief.

definitions.gloss: bringing to light, highlighting, making clear
definitions.explanation: Making a problem, issue, or fact stand out clearly, as if in relief. Most commonly used in the figurative expression {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる (to come to light, to be highlighted).

examples.japanese: {神殿|しんでん}の{壁|かべ}に{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りがある。
examples.english: There are relief carvings on the temple walls.

examples.japanese: この{装飾|そうしょく}は{大理石|だいりせき}の{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りで{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This decoration is made from marble relief carving.

examples.japanese: {問題点|もんだいてん}が{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになった。
examples.english: The problems were brought to light.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{事件|じけん}で{制度|せいど}の{欠陥|けっかん}が{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになった。
examples.english: This incident brought the flaws in the system to light.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}によって{地域|ちいき}{間|かん}の{格差|かくさ}が{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りにされた。
examples.english: The survey highlighted the disparity between regions.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}が{起|お}きるたびに、インフラの{脆弱|ぜいじゃく}さが{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる。
examples.english: Every time a disaster occurs, the fragility of the infrastructure is highlighted.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is far more common in modern Japanese. The key expression is {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる (to become highlighted / to come to light) or {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りにする (to bring to light / to highlight). Very common in news and formal writing when discussing problems, issues, or facts that have become apparent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる: to come to light, to be highlighted
- {浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りにする: to bring to light, to highlight
- {問題|もんだい}が{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる: problems come to light
- {課題|かだい}が{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}りになる: issues are highlighted
